description: Ex-SAAF Impala acquired privately and standing on the grounds of the Chrysalis Academy, a Western Cape youth development academy in Tokai Forest, formerly Porter School. Brought by road from AFB Bloemspruit. The instrumentation has been stripped out although the ejection seats remain, and it carries a Firewatch group decal on the rear fuselage. Photographed on site in October 2013; no later sighting was found. Access requires permission from both the Academy and the aircraft's owner.
